a.lede: The FCC has granted SpaceX's request to deploy 1 million satellites to build an AI data center in orbit.
a.title: SpaceX gets FCC approval to deploy 1 million satellites for its AI orbital data center

b.lede: In an announcement on Wednesday, the FCC says it authorized SpaceX to deploy up to 1 million AI chip-equipped satellites as part of the Elon Musk-owned company's "Starmind" initiative. b.title: FCC signs off on SpaceX’s plan to put up to 1 million data center satellites into space
